build-android.description: Build Android debug APK (builds renderer, syncs Capacitor, and runs gradlew assembleDebug)
build-android.template: Run `pnpm run android:build` in the terminal to build the mobile web bundle and compile the Android debug APK.

sync-android.description: Compile the web renderer for mobile and sync web assets to the Android Capacitor project
sync-android.template: Run `pnpm run android:sync` to build the mobile bundle and synchronize assets to the Android project.

check.description: Run TypeScript and biome checks on the codebase
check.template: Run `pnpm run check` and `pnpm run check:packages` to verify TypeScript types across packages.
